checks: Forward Euler on y'=-y, y(0)=1 at t=5: error 1.58e-3 (h=0.1), 8.17e-4 (h=0.05), 4.15e-4 (h=0.025); observed order ~ 0.98
Heun on the same problem: error 6.08e-5 (h=0.1), 1.46e-5 (h=0.05), 3.58e-6 (h=0.025); observed order ~ 2.03
LTE = O(h^2) for forward Euler, global error = O(h); LTEs O(h^{p+1}) -> global O(h^p)
Forward Euler stability for y'=lambda y requires |1+h*lambda| <= 1, i.e. h <= 2/|lambda|; lambda=-100 -> h <= 0.02
At h=0.03, |1+h*lambda| = 2 > 1, so forward Euler is unstable
